    Roles read from the provider's token instead of the application's own data.
    Oidc
    OpenID Connect for one app: bearer access tokens from any of its providers, and browser sign-in through the authorization code flow with PKCE, which ends in a Security session renewed with the refresh token.
    OidcModule
    OpenID Connect for an app: the Oidc service as a way to authenticate and to renew sessions, a sign-in for each configured provider, and the /auth/oidc/{provider}/login and /callback routes.
